route.title: Greedy gcd sequence via finite minimal divisibility classes
route.mathematicalIdea: Use the supplied proof: characterize sequence terms as the global gcd-admissible set above the first term; show that set is generated by finitely many minimal squarefree divisibility classes; obtain periodic membership and then a translated enumeration.
orderedMilestones: Show the sequence enumerates the globally gcd-admissible set above its first term.
Prove pairwise noncoprimality in the admissible set and the missing-integer witness lemma.
Use squarefree kernels and minimal divisibility classes; prove finite prime support with the descent lemma.
Take a common multiple of the finite classes to obtain periodic membership, then transfer periodicity to the ordered sequence.
assumptionsUsed: Each next term is the least larger integer whose gcd with every earlier term exceeds 1.
mathematicalRisks: Formalizing the descent on minimal squarefree classes and finite prime support.
Transferring periodic set membership to a fixed positive index shift for the enumeration.

entries.collectionRationale: The user supplied one complete mathematical proof, so one fresh route follows its ordered argument.
